title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (gorm) — review required
description: In gorm, .Wheres*([^)]*+ mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via ? placeholders.
applicability: gorm data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
